about.seoDescription: Why {name} makes hallmarked gold jewellery to be worn every day and passed down for generations.
about.title: Gold, the way
about.accent: it was meant to be bought
about.first: {name} takes its name from Akshaya Tritiya, the day families across India have long set aside to buy gold, in the belief that what is bought then never diminishes.
about.second: We carry that idea into every piece we make. Our gold is hallmarked so its purity is never in question. Our designs draw on the necklaces, jhumkas and bangles our grandmothers wore, reworked to be light enough for today. And every piece is finished and checked by hand before it reaches you, so it can be worn often and passed on.
about.alt: A woman wearing a gold choker with an emerald centre and a matching stud earring
about.valueOneText: Each gold piece is BIS hallmarked with its unique HUID, and its karatage is stated plainly, so you always know exactly what you are buying.
about.valueTwoText: Our craftspeople finish, polish and inspect every piece. Small details, like a smooth clasp or a well-set stone, are what make jewellery last.
about.valueThreeText: We design for the moments that matter, a wedding, a first salary, a festival morning, and for the generations who will wear the piece next.
about.careOne: Put your jewellery on last, after perfume, lotion and hairspray.
about.careTwo: Take it off before swimming, bathing or exercising.
about.careThree: Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth after wearing.
about.careFour: Store each piece on its own in a soft pouch so it doesn't scratch.
about.careAlt: A hand lifting a long gold chain with mother-of-pearl charms
